remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”.

The form factor of a product like Muse is you want to be able to hand off a task to the agent and ensure that it is fully completed end to end. To do this, the agent must be able to successfully operate with your tools or use its own to complete the task. Use your MCP or CLI, easily navigate your site, be able to transact, and more.

The new attention you need to compete for is not from the user itself but instead for the agent. This means that the tools that allow agents to order food, handle ecommerce transactions, book flights, work with the local economy, and interact with our data and information best, are the ones that will get used the most.

This will ultimately be the biggest opportunity and shakeup in consumer tech since the App Store itself.
remarks.translation: 个人智能体是“打造智能体真正想要的东西”这一理念的终极体现。像 Muse 这样的产品形态，核心在于你能够把任务交给智能体，并确保它端到端地完整执行。要做到这一点，智能体必须能够顺利使用你的工具，或运用自身工具来完成任务。它要能使用你的 MCP 或 CLI，轻松浏览你的网站，具备交易能力，等等。如今你需要争夺的新注意力，不再来自用户本身，而是来自智能体。这意味着，那些能让智能体最顺畅地订餐、处理电商交易、预订航班、与本地经济互动，以及访问我们的数据和信息的工具，将会被最频繁地使用。这最终将成为自 App Store 以来消费科技领域最大的机遇与变革。
remarks.observation: 这条言论可作为 Agent 产品形态、协作方式或能力边界的观察入口；只代表公开观点，不作为公司事实主证据。

podcasts.title: 🔬“我们有语言的基础模型，但没有物理学的基础模型”——Anima Anandkumar，计算学Bren讲席教授
podcasts.originalTitle: 🔬“We have foundation models for language, not for physics” — Anima Anandkumar, Bren Professor of Computing
podcasts.excerpt: 几年前，加州理工学院教授、Accelerated Understanding联合创始人Anima Anandkumar着手开发首个基于AI的开源天气模型。在与该领域专家交流时，她遇到了质疑。天气是混沌的，物理模拟很难，已经发展了几十年，而且需要超级计算机，数据根本不够。尽管有这些保留意见，Anima还是坚持前行并着手构建。不到一年，她的团队就开发出了FourCastNet，一个能与现有最佳物理模拟相媲美的预测模型。多亏了Anima及其后续工作，现在任何人都可以使用消费级GPU在短时间尺度上准确预测天气。在我们发布的约十五集科学节目中，<a target="_blank" href="http://latent.…
podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs. In the fifteen or so science episodes we’ve released on <a target="_blank" href="http://latent.…
